notes: All calls, units, assignments, communications and movements are fictional.
Real geography (road network, staging-area locations, surge planning zones) provides realistic operating conditions only.
Documented bridge closures from the Lee County AAR are applied with a modeled onset time; their documented report time is used as the latest time dispatch learns of them.
Service suspension window is informed by the AAR (suspension at 10:45 a.m. Sept 28; search and rescue began ~2:00 a.m. Sept 29).
